description: Reads one entry of RestaurantDoctorAI's library in full (a guide, a blog post, a playbook fix, the targets, a fact or a knowledge entry), by the id restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge or restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge gave, with its title, link and source. Use it when a passage isn't enough to answer well. A long entry comes 8,000 characters at a time, with its total length: send the nextOffset it gives as offset for the next part. The query isn't stored; only an anonymous daily count of searches and reads is kept.

id.description: An entry id from restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge or restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge, e.g. 'guide:restaurant-prime-cost' or 'post:restaurant-break-even-point'.

offset.description: Where to start, in characters (default 0, the start). A long entry comes 8,000 characters at a time: send the nextOffset a read gave for the next part.

name: restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge

anyOf.description: Where the next part starts: send it as offset to restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge.

offset.description: Where this part starts, in characters.

source.description: Who says so, with the date it was checked or updated where there is one.

text.description: The entry's text from offset, up to 8,000 characters.

totalLength.description: The whole entry's length, in characters.

truncated.description: More of the entry follows this part (nextOffset says where).

url.description: Where a reader can check it: the page on restaurantdoctorai.com, or the fact's own source.

title: Read a library entry
